A score needs participant evidence -- race reports, runner blogs, attributed quotes -- and without it would be invention.
title: Sanur Bali International Half Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Sanur Bali Half Marathon 2027 Review | Beach Half, Bali
meta_description: Sanur Bali International Half Marathon review: about 5,000 runners on the Mertasari beachfront in 2026, opened by Bali's governor. What to expect in 2027.
dek: A beachfront half marathon on Bali's quieter east coast that drew around 5,000 runners in 2026 and was opened by the governor. Here is what the last edition was like, and what to expect from the 2027 race.
verdict: The Sanur Bali International Half Marathon is a young event with real backing. The 2026 edition on Sunday 8 February on the beachfront at Mertasari, Sanur, drew around 5,000 runners [1] -- the organisers put it at 4,500 from 34 countries [2] -- and was formally opened by Bali's governor, Wayan Koster [1]. It is organised by RajaLARI with Prama Sanur Beach Bali and the support of the Denpasar city government [1][2], and it is being built deliberately as a sport-tourism fixture [1]. It is a half marathon with a setting most races cannot offer, and Sanur is the calmer side of Bali to stay in.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The 2026 race was held on Sunday 8 February at Mertasari Beach in Sanur, over 5 km, 10 km and a 21 km half marathon [1]. Around 5,000 runners took part, from across Indonesia and abroad [1].

Reports differ slightly on the exact figure: the organisers' own account gives 4,500 runners from 34 countries [2]. Either way, it is a substantial field for an event of its age, and a notably international one.

sections.heading: Beachfront Bali, Without the Crowds
paragraphs: The event bills itself as Bali's first half marathon with a beach setting [2], and Mertasari is the reason. Sanur, on the island's south-east coast, is the quieter, more residential alternative to Kuta and Seminyak, with a long beachfront path and calmer water.

For a travelling runner, that makes it one of the more appealing destination halves in the region: an early race by the sea, followed by a few days somewhere noticeably less hectic than the rest of southern Bali.

sections.heading: Who Runs It
paragraphs: The organising committee was headed by I Gusti Bagus Surya, general manager of Prama Sanur Beach Bali, with the support of the Denpasar city government [1]. RajaLARI is the race organiser [2].

Official backing was visible: the 2026 race was opened by Governor Wayan Koster [1], and officials said they hoped it would become an annual international fixture and an icon of sport tourism for Denpasar [1]. That kind of civic commitment usually means road closures and logistics are taken seriously.
The finisher medal carries the theme of Tri Hita Karana, the Balinese philosophy of harmony between people, nature and the divine [2] -- a small touch, but one that gives the race a sense of place.

sections.heading: What to Expect in 2027
paragraphs: The 2027 edition is scheduled for Sunday 7 February, again over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon, with entry from Rp490,000 [3].

That is one day earlier in the calendar than 2026 and keeps the event in its established early-February slot. February is inside Bali's wet season, so expect humidity and the possibility of rain rather than dry heat.

sections.heading: Should You Enter?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a destination half marathon in a genuinely attractive setting. The beachfront course, the international field and Sanur's calmer character make it an easy race to build a short trip around.
It is not a race for a fast time: the event is young, the course is built for atmosphere, and February weather in Bali is unpredictable. Come for the setting and the occasion.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the previous edition and the organisers' own announcements. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many runners took part in the Sanur Bali International Half Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: Around 5,000 runners took part on Sunday 8 February 2026 at Mertasari Beach, Sanur. The organisers' own account gives 4,500 runners from 34 countries, so the field was large and notably international for an event of its age.

faqs.question: Where does the Sanur Bali International Half Marathon take place?
faqs.answer: On the beachfront at Mertasari in Sanur, on Bali's south-east coast. Sanur is the quieter, more residential side of southern Bali compared with Kuta and Seminyak, which makes it an easy base for a short running trip.

faqs.question: Who organises the Sanur Bali International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: RajaLARI organises the race with Prama Sanur Beach Bali, and the 2026 organising committee was headed by the hotel's general manager, I Gusti Bagus Surya. The Denpasar city government supports it, and Governor Wayan Koster opened the 2026 edition.
